feature_name: Capacity Planner reservation utilization history view and export
summary: Capacity Planner preview provides viewing and export of historical utilization for on-demand and future reservations for VMs and GPUs.
extended_definition: Capacity Planner reservation utilization history view and export is a preview capability announced on November 15, 2024 that lets users view and export historical utilization for on-demand and future reservation requests (VM and GPU-related) within a project, folder, or organization. In Capacity Planner usage/forecast guidance, reservation visibility includes current on-demand reservations as well as past and current future reservation requests, which supports planning against historical and forecast context.
